name: @beauclick/wishlist-contract
description: The browser-safe half of the wishlist contract: the closed target-type vocabulary, the closed refusal vocabulary, and the cap, page-size and cursor limits. Zero dependencies, no framework, no TypeORM -- so the Next.js bundle and the NestJS server share ONE definition instead of two that drift. Deliberately carries NO target-state vocabulary (Story #9), no display field, and no count of any kind.
